scope.summary: Implement primitive panel shape constructors (Rectangle, Circle/Ellipse, Polygon) that emit a closed EdgeShape outline into GarmentSpec as a new Panel
acceptance_criteria: author_panel_rect(width_cm, height_cm, corner_radius_cm) produces a Panel with 4 Line EdgeShapes (or Bezier corners when radius>0) meeting at right-angles, closed outline verified by PANEL_CLOSED descriptor
author_panel_circle(radius_cm) produces a Panel with a single Bezier-approximate closed ellipse EdgeShape
author_panel_polygon(vertices: Vec<[f32;2]>) produces a Panel with N Line EdgeShape segments and a closed outline
All three primitives emit TailorPanelCrdtUpdateRecorded; GarmentSpec spec_json updated in tailor_panels row
PANEL_CLOSED ValidationDescriptor passes for every constructed primitive
Model-accessible via the edit_panel MCP tool with a shape_preset field (rect/circle/polygon) and dimension params

All operator-facing scope is implemented in src/frontend/handshake_native with native wgpu/egui, AccessKit author_id, Argus inspection/steering/capture, and no Tailor React, Tauri-command, WebView, data-testid-only, or rendered-PNG frontend path.

The exact TailorSurfaceDescriptor row MT-338 enumerates every route, pane, control author_id, dynamic entity-key rule, action, state, help anchor, permission, undo policy, receipt, and command binding; wildcard-only evidence is rejected.

Applicable blank, loading, populated, stale/conflict, cancelled, failed, retry, permission, keyboard/focus, narrow/4K/DPI, overlap/clipping, and no-focus-steal states are covered by the registry-derived Argus matrix.
scope.risk_if_missed: Models and operators have no way to start a garment from scratch; every GarmentSpec must be authored as raw JSON with no tooling aid. The starter template library (MT-137) partially compensates but only for the 5 seeded archetypes. Any novel shape requires hand-writing coordinate arrays, which is error-prone and blocks the model-first authoring path for non-template garments.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

surfaces: native Tailor pane and applicable editor, viewport, browser, timeline, or status surface

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Pattern authoring, sewing, and arrangement

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT must wire the shared internal_diagnostics API for its native, job, device, solver-run, or DCC failure modes with bounded structured evidence.
Long-running, native, or external-process work must register bounded progress and child/process identity with the shared Palmistry watcher; Tailor must not fork a watcher.

required_changes_before_execution: Replace legacy app/src or app/src-tauri targets with the native Handshake shell and native Tailor paths.
Bind this scope to the native 2D Pattern pane, shared selection/property/history, and queued topology transaction contracts.
Added gui_obligation, user_manual_obligation, and HBR-INT-009 tier obligations from the current MT template without removing original scope.
Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.
